competences.description: Attacks the enemy to increase its chances of landing a Glancing Hit for 2 turns with a 50% chance.

Spooky ghosts appear from the bag to attack all enemies 2 times. The first hit removes 1 beneficial effect with a 50% chance, and the second hit decreases the Attack Speed for 2 turns with a 50% chance.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
The target's Attack Speed will be decreased by 30%.

competences.description: For each harmful effect granted on allies (including yourself), increases the damage dealt by 20%, up to 200%, and decreases the damage taken by 5%, up to 50%. Grants 1 of the harmful effects granted on yourself to the target when you attack. In addition, ignores all the harmful effects granted on yourself and gains immunity against Oblivion. [Automatic Effect]

effets.note: Per harmful effect granted on all allies, up to 200%

effets.description: Decreases damage received by a certain amount
effets.note: Per harmful effect granted on yourself

effets.description: Removes a debuff from casting monster and applies it to the target monster.
